meta.name: The Way Home
meta.description:
When three generations of women reunite after being estranged for more than two decades, they embark on an enlightening – and surprising – journey toward healing none of them could have imagined as they learn how to find their way back to each other.

Not complete. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 2/10 (missing E3-10) | S3 not on server | S4 not on server

videos.title: Mothers and Daughters
videos.overview: Kat and her teen daughter Alice move in with estranged grandma Del. Escaping the tension, Alice explores the farm and finds herself on a surprising journey.

videos.title: Scar Tissue
videos.overview: Kat is presented with a book deal that asks her to dredge up terrible memories. Del wants to say goodbye to the past, while Alice yearns to return there.

videos.title: I Don't Want to Miss a Thing
videos.overview: Alice falls in love with the past and has her first kiss. Kat starts a job at the local paper. Del deals with bittersweet memories attached to Colton's boat.

videos.title: What's My Age Again?
videos.overview: Alice double dates with her parents as teens. Kat's first visit to the past brings a surprising discovery. Del swallows her pride to ask for help.

videos.title: Don't Dream It's Over
videos.overview: Kat chaperones a school dance and reconnects with Brady. Alice wants Nick to find her in the future. Del says goodbye to more memories as a landmark closes.

videos.title: Building a Mystery
videos.overview: Kat and Alice try to stop Jacob's disappearance. Del realizes the tragedy of Jacob was not hers alone, but the whole town's, and moves toward healing.

videos.title: The End of the World as We Know It
videos.overview: Alice goes to a New Year's Eve Y2K party to support her friend. Kat finds a new mystery about her father, while Del reveals an old secret about him that's troubled her.

videos.title: Lovefool
videos.overview: When an old friend returns, Alice realizes her relationship has no future, and Kat is shocked by family secrets. Del tries to take a chance with Byron.

videos.title: The Day the Music Died
videos.overview: After learning that Colton wasn’t having an affair, Kat is determined to unearth the truth about his accident and dispel the rumors that it was on purpose. When Kat shares with Del that he wasn’t unfaithful to her, Del’s memories are painted in a new light. Despite their best efforts, Elliot and Alice aren’t able to dissuade Kat from returning to 2000 to try and change the course of events.

videos.title: Not All Who Wander Are Lost
videos.overview: Kat and Alice travel back to 2000 together to attend Colton’s  funeral. Elliot tells Kat she should share with Alice the truth about her visits to the past. Meanwhile, Del goes to the grief group and makes peace with her memory of Colton. Kat has an epiphany that sheds new light on Jacob’s disappearance.

videos.title: The Space Between
videos.overview: Del recreates traditions of family summers past, Alice misses her friends, and Kat grapples with Jacob’s mystery in the wake of losing Elliot.

videos.title: Hanging by a Moment
videos.overview: Del considers the future of Landry Farm in the present, Kat searches for answers through the past, and Alice tries to make peace with Elliot in both.

meta.slogan: Every past ends in the present.
